buildCommand: set -e; OUT=.vercel-static; echo "[build] pwd=$(pwd)"; echo "[build] ls:"; ls -1 | head -30; if [ -f public/index.html ]; then SRC=public; elif [ -f index.html ]; then SRC=.; else echo "[build] ERROR: no index.html in ./public or ."; ls -la; exit 1; fi; echo "[build] source=$SRC"; rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; tar -cf - --exclude=./$OUT --exclude=./backend --exclude=./functions --exclude=./node_modules --exclude=./.git --exclude=./scripts -C "$SRC" . | tar -xf - -C "$OUT"; echo "[build] files=$(find $OUT -type f | wc -l)"; test -f "$OUT/index.html" || { echo "[build] ERROR: index.html missing in $OUT"; exit 1; }; echo "[build] OK"
